tags.name: Delivery Man Auth
tags.description: POST /delivery-man/login, /register, /password/forgot, /password/verify-otp, PUT /password/reset, PUT /password/change. Approve pending drivers: `npm run approve-riders`.

tags.name: Delivery Man Profile
tags.description: GET /delivery-man/whoami, GET /profile, PUT /profile/status (online toggle). Bearer JWT required.

tags.name: Delivery Man Orders
tags.description: GET /orders/active, GET /orders/latest (pool), GET /orders/history (My Orders), PUT /orders/{id}/accept, PUT /orders/{id}/status. E2E: consumer place → vendor confirm → latest → accept → delivered (records earnings).

tags.name: Delivery Man Home
tags.description: GET /delivery-man/home — today / week / month order counts + today's earning.

tags.name: Delivery Man Earnings
tags.description: GET /delivery-man/earnings — wallet summary, period totals, paginated history with full order + items.

tags.name: Delivery Man Notifications
tags.description: GET /delivery-man/notifications, DELETE /notifications/{id}, PUT /fcm-token. Paginated inbox + FCM device token.

tags.name: Delivery Man Chat
tags.description: Driver messaging (PHP /api/v1/delivery-man/message/*). Chat with customer and vendor. Socket: `delivery_man:{id}` room + `watch_conversation`.

bearerAuth.description: **Customer JWT** — from POST `/consumer/login` or `/consumer/sign-in-with-google` (`data.token`). **Guest JWT** — from POST `/consumer/guest/request` (`data.token`, claim `role: guest`); valid for cart (and guest checkout flows), not for profile/favourites/addresses.

PlaceOrderRequest.description: Checkout payload. Use saved address via delivery_address_id, or inline address fields when no id. For delivery, distance (km) is required. Cart checkout: omit items/cart and use DB cart; buy-now: set is_buy_now true with items (or cart array). Guest checkout: send guest_id from POST /consumer/guest/request when not using Bearer token.

price.description: Optional for buy-now; server uses menu price when loading from cart DB

address.description: Required for delivery if delivery_address_id omitted
